records.key: Organise images and their masks into the layout Measure reads. Either give a source folder and sort it with a regex, or drop files and folders into the columns below: each column is a channel or a mask, each row one field, and dropped files are matched across the columns by name. On Apply the images and masks are MOVED into Yokogawa-named channel folders and merged into merged/; every move is written to a manifest.
records.source: Organise images and their masks into the layout Measure reads. Either give a source folder and sort it with a regex, or drop files and folders into the columns below: each column is a channel or a mask, each row one field, and dropped files are matched across the columns by name. On Apply the images and masks are MOVED into Yokogawa-named channel folders and merged into merged/; every move is written to a manifest.
records.translation: Ordna bilder och deras masker i den struktur som Measure läser. Ange antingen en källmapp och sortera den med ett regex, eller släpp filer och mappar i kolumnerna nedan: varje kolumn är en kanal eller en mask, varje rad ett fält, och släppta filer matchas mellan kolumnerna efter namn. Vid Verkställ FLYTTAS bilderna och maskerna till kanalmappar med Yokogawa-namn och slås samman i merged/; varje flytt skrivs till ett manifest.

Apply moves them into Yokogawa-named channel folders and merges them into merged/.
records.source: Put images and their masks into the layout Measure reads: one popup with the source folder, Mask generation's regex options and a table with a column per channel and per mask, which takes dropped files and folders. Apply moves them into Yokogawa-named channel folders and merges them into merged/.

Verkställ flyttar dem till kanalmappar med Yokogawa-namn och slår samman dem i merged/.
